verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Claude accepts PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX and other document types. Files can go into individual chats or into project files for persistent reference, and Claude analyzes both text and visual elements such as charts in PDFs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of analysis accuracy, documented spreadsheet-analysis depth beyond format support, and detail on limits beyond the 100-page PDF visual-analysis cap.
